teleporter/31147.htm.text: Sobling: Nice to meet you. Let me introduce myself: my name is Sobling, and I'm an archeologist. My job is to find the truth by solving the puzzles of past. Although I'm old enough to be your grandfather, my heart beats as fast as a teenager whenever I'm about to embark on a new excavation. I'm esp…

Q00376_ExplorationOfTheGiantsCavePart1/3.text: Expedition Leader Sobling: It is now possible to explore the upper level of the Giant's Cave thanks to the help of many adventurers. Because of that, now we can finally undertake a more rigorous expedition. It will be more dangerous than past forays into the Giant's Cave, but I hope you will help u…

Expedition Leader Sobling: We are trying to organize a serious exploration of the upper level of the Giant's Cave, but it's very dangerous. As much as I need help, I couldn't possibly ask you. (Only characters who level 79 or above may undertake this quest.)

Expedition Captain Sobling: This, this is definitely the Knowledge of the Giants Anthology...! You must have had a hard time to find this precious one. Thank you so much. But, what can i help you with?
when: state STARTED; hasQuestItems(player, BOOK1, BOOK2, BOOK3, BOOK4, BOOK5)

Q00376_ExplorationOfTheGiantsCavePart1/3.text: Expedition Leader Sobling: I can't reward you for rumors or worthless trinkets. You must bring back authentic relics of real value!
when: state STARTED; NOT hasQuestItems(player, BOOK1, BOOK2, BOOK3, BOOK4, BOOK5)

Q00376_ExplorationOfTheGiantsCavePart1/3.text: Researcher Sobling: Thank you. Hunt down Klennot, Hamlet, Palit, Imagro and Cursed Lord, Cursed Guardian, Cursed Seer, Hirokai in Upper Giant's Cave and retrieve Legacy of Ancient, Knowledge of the Giants Anthology . For your information, you have to bring chapters from 1 to 5. And one more thing! …
Expedition Captain Sobling: Rewards appropriate to your effort are always ready. If you make enough effort, you can take anything. Take a look to see if you need anything.
Researcher Sobling: I can spot a good adventurer from a mile away. I look forward to working with you again.
Expedition Leader Sobling: Too bad. I was hoping you could help us...
